_changes: 0.4.2: extended hook coverage (rred-36). PowerShell folded into pre-bash matcher (Bash|PowerShell) so Windows/pwsh has the same strict-prefix + path-guard + struct-file rules. Three new fixed-deny matchers: mcp__.* (high-density PII, no per-server redaction), Grep (bypasses Read+path-guard via matching lines — redirect to `redactor wrap -- rg/grep` via Bash), NotebookEdit (not used in this profile). Monitor intentionally NOT hooked.

0.4.1: removed PostToolUse Read|Bash sanitizer (post-tool). pre-bash's struct-file guard already forces structured outputs through `redactor --type X <file>` (direct mode, sanitizes before stdout). For non-structured streams, `redactor wrap` runs pattern-mode at wrap-time. Tradeoff: no second-pass safety net for long-running wraps if rules change mid-stream.
0.3.0: hooks moved into the redactor binary
_comment: Strict-redaction hook config. All hooks are served by the redactor binary.
_hook_design: Pre-tool: path-guard + bash-strict + network-guard (Bash|PowerShell), read-strict (Read), fixed-deny (mcp__.*, Grep, NotebookEdit). Post-tool: per-extension Write/Edit validators only.
